guideContent.strategyOverview: Fíli the Pathfinder pays you twice for every nontoken Dwarf that enters: a 2/2 red Dwarf token, and progress toward storied — control 3+ artifacts, legendaries, or Sagas once and Fíli's +1/+1 anthem stays on for the rest of the game (14 legendaries plus the rock suite switch it on around turn 3-4). The deck stacks three multipliers on that trigger: 16 Dwarves whose ETBs do real work, a flicker suite that re-buys those ETBs, and token doublers (Mondrak, Anointed Procession) with trigger doublers (Panharmonicon, Roaming Throne naming Dwarf). Maskwood Nexus turns every nontoken creature into a Fíli trigger. Changelings count as Dwarves natively. The primary win is go-wide combat through Moonshaker Cavalry, Mirror Entity, Cathars' Crusade, and An Unexpected Party. The ceiling line is Felidar Guardian + Restoration Angel: infinite ETBs that Cathars' Crusade converts into an arbitrarily large board (the loop pieces are not Dwarves, so Fíli adds no tokens to the loop itself). Manabase is a 38-land plan: 36 real lands plus 3 pay-life modal MDFCs, 39 land-playable cards in total.

deckCategories.name: Dwarven Fuel
deckCategories.description: Nontoken Dwarves with jobs. Each one advances the board and leaves a 2/2 behind. Draw (Kíli, Tataru Taru, Priest of Ancient Lore), removal on bodies (Fairgrounds Warden, Deadeye Harpooner, Ori, Shattered Acolyte), protection (Bofur, Dáin), ramp (Stoic Farmer), recursion (Master Skald), and re-buy loops (Aviary Mechanic, Stockpiling Celebrant, Aethergeode Miner).
cards: Dáin, Lord of the Iron Hills

deckCategories.name: Changelings
deckCategories.description: Both changelings are nontoken Dwarves for Fíli and every creature type for the kindred payoffs. Mirror Entity doubles as a finisher with its {X} overrun activation; Universal Automaton is a one-mana Dwarf that any flicker re-buys.

deckCategories.name: Blink Value & Combo Core
deckCategories.description: Creatures whose ETBs are worth re-buying. Felidar Guardian + Restoration Angel is the infinite-ETB core; both are strong value cards alone. Skyclave Apparition and Solemn Simulacrum are premium flicker targets; Esper Sentinel and Bennie Bracks keep cards flowing.

deckCategories.name: Flicker Suite
deckCategories.description: Every flicker of a nontoken Dwarf repeats its ETB and makes another 2/2. Eerie Interlude doubles as board-wipe insurance that returns the team with a fresh wave of triggers, and a kicked The Eagles Are Coming! bounces the team instead — each returned creature (tokens included) becomes a 4/4 flying Bird Soldier, doubled by Mondrak or Anointed Procession. Airbender Ascension flickers a creature you control at every end step once it hits four quest counters, and Appa's flash ETB airbends the nontoken board out of a wipe — with the caveat that airbended tokens cease to exist and counters on airbended cards are gone. Cards cast out of airbend exile are real casts, so they re-fire Fíli's token trigger and Appa's Ally trigger.

deckCategories.name: Multipliers & Glue
deckCategories.description: Panharmonicon and Roaming Throne (naming Dwarf) double the triggers; Mondrak and Anointed Procession double the tokens (multipliers stack multiplicatively). Maskwood Nexus makes every nontoken creature a Fíli trigger — with the documented anti-synergy that Restoration Angel cannot target our all-Angel board while Nexus is out.

deckCategories.name: Anthems & Finishers
deckCategories.description: Cathars' Crusade turns every token wave (and the combo) into lethal stats. An Unexpected Party names Dwarf and its adventure half makes X 2/2 Dwarves. Flowering of the White Tree pumps the whole board. Moonshaker Cavalry is the white Craterhoof. Emeria's Call adds a flood-mode Angel burst.
cards: An Unexpected Party // At the Door

deckCategories.name: Interaction
deckCategories.description: Six removal spells plus two token-army protectors. Winds of Abandon is one-sided mass exile. Clever Concealment phases the whole board out for {W}-ish with convoke (phased tokens survive — rules changed in 2017). Witch Enchanter and Razorgrass Ambush ride land slots.

deckCategories.name: Draw, Tutor & Ramp
deckCategories.description: The One Ring, Tocasia's Welcome (MV-based, so the anthem never breaks it), and Caretaker's Talent carry card advantage. Enlightened Tutor finds the best engine piece. The ramp package leans on Plains supply — Land Tax, Archaeomancer's Map, Stoic Farmer, and Deep Gnome Terramancer all fetch basics.

winConditions.title: Felidar Guardian + Restoration Angel
winConditions.description: Felidar Guardian blinks any permanent; Restoration Angel blinks any non-Angel creature. Each points at the other for infinite enter-the-battlefield triggers. The loop needs a converter: Cathars' Crusade makes the whole board arbitrarily large, then any attack wins. The pieces are not Dwarves, so Fíli adds no tokens to the loop itself. Anti-synergy note: while Maskwood Nexus is out, every creature is an Angel and Restoration Angel has no legal target — blink Nexus away first.

winConditions.title: Go-Wide Dwarf Combat
cards: An Unexpected Party // At the Door
winConditions.description: The default win: 2-4 tokens per turn cycle before multipliers, pumped by Fíli's storied anthem and Flowering of the White Tree, then closed with Moonshaker Cavalry's flying overrun, Mirror Entity's {X} activation, or An Unexpected Party's X-token burst into Cathars' Crusade triggers.

synergies.title: Felidar Guardian + Restoration Angel
synergies.description: The two-card infinite ETB loop that sets the deck's bracket label. Each half is a playable value blink card on its own, which is why the deck runs them without tutoring pressure.

sources.name: Commander Spellbook — Felidar Guardian + Restoration Angel

synergies.title: Fíli + Roaming Throne
synergies.description: Throne names Dwarf and doubles Fíli's token trigger: every nontoken Dwarf entering now makes two 2/2s before token multipliers, and Throne is a legendary artifact creature for storied.

synergies.title: Fíli + Mondrak + Anointed Procession
synergies.description: Token multipliers stack multiplicatively (CR 616): one trigger through both doublers makes four tokens. Every other token producer in the deck (An Unexpected Party, Emeria's Call, Caretaker's Talent) scales the same way.

synergies.title: Panharmonicon + the Dwarf ETB corps
synergies.description: Panharmonicon doubles every creature and artifact ETB trigger the deck is built around — draw, removal, and Fíli's own token trigger all fire twice.

synergies.title: Maskwood Nexus + Fíli
synergies.description: Nexus makes every nontoken creature a Dwarf, so off-tribe value creatures (Skyclave Apparition, Solemn Simulacrum, Esper Sentinel) stop costing us tokens. It also feeds storied as an artifact.

synergies.title: Cathars' Crusade + the token stream
cards: An Unexpected Party // At the Door
synergies.description: Every token wave puts a +1/+1 counter on the whole army. With multiple tokens entering at once, boards grow explosively — and it is the payoff that converts the infinite blink loop into a win.

synergies.title: Deadeye Harpooner + flicker
synergies.description: Revolt is nearly always on in a flicker deck — the flicker itself makes a permanent leave the battlefield, so Harpooner's ETB kill clause turns on when you re-buy it.

synergies.title: Bennie Bracks + the token engine
synergies.description: Bennie draws on each end step where a token was created earlier that turn — most turns in this deck, and flash plays add opponent-turn draws. Note the intervening-if: a token made during the end step itself (for example by Teleportation Circle's blink) is too late for that turn's check.

synergies.title: Airbender Ascension + the token stream
synergies.description: Ascension's quest counters come from any creature you control entering, tokens included. With Fíli out, one nontoken Dwarf drop is worth 2 counters (the Dwarf plus its 2/2), 3 with Mondrak or Anointed Procession, 5 with both — so two Dwarf drops clear the four-counter threshold with no doubler at all. The counters are never removed, so from then on it is a free end-step flicker of one of your creatures every turn: re-buy a Dwarf ETB and collect another 2/2. Its own enter trigger airbends up to one target creature; on your own nontoken Dwarf that is a {2} recast for a fresh ETB, and recasting from exile is a real cast, so Fíli's trigger fires again.

synergies.title: Appa + cast-from-exile
synergies.description: Appa flashes in for {2}{W}{W} and airbends any number of your other nonland permanents, which is a fifth piece of wipe insurance alongside Eerie Interlude, Clever Concealment, Flawless Maneuver, and a kicked The Eagles Are Coming!. Two limits are real: airbended tokens cease to exist, so the 2/2 army is not saved — only nontoken permanents come back; and counters on airbended cards are gone, which matters with Cathars' Crusade counters on the board. Each exiled card then costs {2} to recast, and every one of those recasts is a spell cast from exile, so Appa makes a 1/1 Ally token for each while nontoken Dwarves also re-trigger Fíli.

highlights.name: The One Ring
highlights.reason: The best colorless draw engine in the format: protection from everything on entry, then an escalating draw every turn. A legendary artifact that switches storied on by itself alongside any rock.

highlights.name: Smothering Tithe
highlights.reason: Fires on every opponent draw (×3 per turn cycle minimum) and the Treasures are artifacts for storied. Funds Mirror Entity activations and double-spell turns.

highlights.name: Enlightened Tutor
highlights.reason: One mana at instant speed for the best engine piece for the board state: Cathars' Crusade, Panharmonicon, Anointed Procession, Maskwood Nexus, or The Arkenstone.

highlights.name: Roaming Throne
highlights.reason: Named on Dwarf it doubles Fíli's token trigger and every other Dwarf's triggered ability, on a ward-2 legendary artifact body that feeds storied.

highlights.name: Mondrak, Glory Dominus
highlights.reason: Token doubler on a legendary body with built-in protection via its oil-counter activation. Stacks multiplicatively with Anointed Procession.

highlights.name: Panharmonicon
highlights.reason: Doubles every creature and artifact ETB trigger in a deck built entirely around them — including Fíli's own token trigger.

highlights.name: Cathars' Crusade
highlights.reason: The payoff that scales with token count and converts the Felidar Guardian + Restoration Angel loop into an arbitrarily large board.

highlights.name: Maskwood Nexus
highlights.reason: Every nontoken creature becomes a Fíli trigger, changelings become everything, and the Rummage-token activation converts dead artifacts into blockers. Documented anti-synergy with Restoration Angel targeting.

highlights.name: An Unexpected Party // At the Door
highlights.reason: Anthem that names Dwarf, and the adventure half is an X-spell token burst that scales with Mondrak, Procession, and Cathars' Crusade.

highlights.name: Moonshaker Cavalry
highlights.reason: The white Craterhoof: flying plus power-equal-to-creature-count pump on a flickerable ETB body. The cleanest closer for a 10+ token board.
